title: Battle Over the Pierre Ends in Defeat for the Buyer Pushed by Lutnick
summary: Motasem Khashoggi, who hails from a prominent Saudi family, missed a Tuesday deadline to deliver a $100 million deposit to purchase the Manhattan landmark.
